purpose: Final pre-inactive-window Week 6 recheck using official/team status, current public market cross-checks, weather, and creator-source context from Evan Abrams/Action Network, Dr. David Chao/SICScore, and Nick Giffen/Action Luck Rankings.
integrity_rules: Do not retroactively change a game after kickoff.
Official NFL/team active/inactive and injury status overrides media or proprietary expectations.
Direct executable sportsbook quotes override public aggregators for any execution claim.
Abrams systems/trends remain context only until independently validated.
SICScore is a medical-effectiveness context layer until prospectively validated.
Giffen Luck Rankings remain a separate external challenger and do not rewrite the canonical model.
Market ranges are preserved when reputable sources disagree rather than collapsed into false precision.
